spec: Separate pure terrain metadata from registered maps so readonly browser field preparation never imports the generated catalog or gameplay mutators; tools load validated catalogs lazily through the same viewer door.
expect: Actual emitted browser modules exclude generated pack, catalog loaders and gameplay mutators. Normal static generation still validates malformed catalogs loudly. Existing CLI bytes, all replay events and controls remain unchanged.
note: Measured dependency cleanup only. One terrain metadata owner, no sideEffects or purity annotations, no validation bypass, no new exemption. Snapshot .12 and gameplay remain unchanged.
